parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no documented police targeting, no facility-exposure rule, and no documented violence against trans visitors — the deliberate-not-counted section confirms the record is silent rather than showing a hostile pattern. Against that: no SOGI anti-discrimination law (2024 amendment blocked), no hate-crime recognition, no documented traveler-facing protections, strong social conservatism (12% marriage approval, organized religious opposition), and a surgery-gated recognition regime that signals limited institutional respect for gender identity. Border treatment and facility practice are open questions, not exposures. One indigenous territory with an accepted third-gender tradition is a genuine but narrow positive. Absence of documented incidents in a moderately documented dossier is weakly positive, but the absence of any protective machinery and the conservative climate hold it below the reduced-risk band. Net: elevated-to-reduced boundary.
